name: Collapsible
description: Shows or hides one region of content behind a trigger.

defaultOpen.description: Whether the collapsible is initially open (uncontrolled)

onOpenChange.description: Called when the trigger opens or closes the content - (open: boolean, eventDetails) => void

disabled.description: Whether the trigger is inert (focusable, dimmed once)

when: Detail most readers do not need
Building a disclosure the other components do not cover
whenNot: Several sections that should coordinate (use Accordion)
Content that must overlay the page (use Dialog or Popover)
guidelines: The trigger should say what opens, not 'click here'
defaultOpen for content most users want on arrival
Keep the trigger to a short phrase
The caret always leads; a bespoke trigger uses render and draws its own glyph
accessibility: Trigger must have aria-expanded to indicate state
Content region needs aria-labelledby pointing to trigger
Focus should remain on trigger after toggle
